newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia awards GSM telecom project to Alcatel.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia awards GSM telecom project to Alcatel.

text.p: Tunisia has awarded France's Alcatel a project to set up a GSM cellular phone system for 30,000 subscribers in the country's main urban, industrial and tourist centres.
Telecommunications industry sources said Alcatel won the project in competition with Germany's Siemens, Sweden's Ericsson, Canada's Northern Telecom and Finland's Nokia.
A Communications Ministry source told Reuters the contract has yet to be signed. He said system should be operational by the first quarter of 1998.
An official at Alcatel-Tunisie, a branch of Alcatel, said he expected the contract to be signed during the next few weeks.
The amount of the contract was not disclosed.
Alcatel group owns 80 percent of the capital of Alcatel-Tunisie which was established in 1990 with private Tunisian businessmen who control a 20 per cent stake.
Its share in the Tunisian telecommunications market is estimated at about 20 percent.
